Subject: Action grid & commitments — MAP kickoff (draft)

Hi Alex —

Great to meet today — thanks for the productive discovery. Attached is the initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft from our call (MAP_draft_v1.xlsx). I pulled together two timeline options and a proposed owner roster so we can lock around a realistic close window.

Quick recap and asks:
- Goals we heard: POC by Aug, production pilot Q4, evaluate through security and performance.
- Two timeline options:
  • Aggressive (6–8 weeks): weekly checkpoints, early integration prototype in 4 weeks.
  • Balanced (10–12 weeks): more time for procurement and legal review, two-stage pilot ramp.
- Proposed milestones (high level):
  1) Runbook & access (Owner: Monica) — week 1–2
  2) Integration prototype (Owner: Monica/Karthik) — week 3–5
  3) Security & compliance signoff (Owner: Aureum security) — week 4–8
  4) Pilot validation & performance gating (Owner: Karthik) — final 1–2 weeks

Dependencies we flagged on the call: SOC 2 scoping, data residency requirements, procurement PO timing, and red-team/pen test scheduling. Please call out any other blockers we missed.

Ask: Can you confirm the Aureum stakeholder roster below and tell us which timeline you prefer (aggressive / balanced / custom)? If you can reply with stakeholder names and procurement timelines by EOD Monday (May 24) we’ll publish the MAP and propose a weekly 30-minute sync.

Proposed internal owners (for your visibility):
- Kimberly Park — executive sponsor / escalation
- Karthik Iyer — solutions lead (integration & performance)
- Monica Patel — integration engineer / day-to-day

Attachments: MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (attachment)
Related: Google Drive MAP draft (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB-map-draft-v1)
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-4279

Thanks — I’ll hold a tentative 60-minute demo on June 3 in case you want a working walkthrough before we finalize owners.

Best,
Kimberly Park
